newsitem.title: USA: H&R Block year tax services volume rises.
newsitem.headline: H&R Block year tax services volume rises.

text.p: H&R Block Inc said worldwide tax services volume for the fiscal year ended April 30 was $1.3 billion, up 15.3-percent over a year ago.
Preliminary figures indicate U.S. volume increased 16.1 percent, while international volume rose 6.5 percent.
Volume comprises tax preparation and related tax services fees generated by nearly 10,000 company-owned and franchised offices in the United States, Canada, Australia and Europe.
The number of clients served worldwide by company-owned and franchised offices increased 4.6 percent to 18.2 million.
Tax returns prepared in all offices in the United States increased 7.1 percent to 14.2 million, while internationally they increased 2.8 percent to two million, Block said.
Electronic returns prepared and filed by U.S. company-owned and franchised offices increased 21.7 percent to 5.9 million through April 30, compared with last year.

The number of returns filed electronically for taxpayers who prepare their own returns declined 5.3 percent, slightly less than expected. verall, the number of returns filed electronically by the company in the United States increased 15.7 percent, while the volume from electronic filing rose 17.2 percent, said the tax and financial services concern.
Corporate earnings for the year ended April 30, 1997, are expected to be available by the end of June, Block said.
